The only consensus found is an undated -$0.53, so tonight's release adds nothing new on the reported quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock moved -4.8% on 11-16 (filing day) and -2.5% intraday on 11-17 on low volume, so the market has already seen the 10-Q. The going-concern language was also in the 10-K of 2026-09-17, after which the stock rallied on the deal.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: filed a day before the call and traded through on 11-16 and 11-17. It is filed so the judges know the quarter is pre-released and does not decide the move.
findings.independence: The EDGAR filing list shows the 10-Q dated 2026-11-16 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001888654&type=10-Q). It shares a document with the financing finding below.

findings.finding: The company has a liquidity gap and a record of discounted equity raises, which makes a financing announcement at or just after the call plausible. Cash was $15.6M at Sep 30, before paying ~$3.4M cash consideration on Oct 1. The bridge facility is $10M, of which $7M was funded and the remaining $3M is conditional. Year-one peak pre-financing need is ~$24M, the acquired business ran at about -$26M of EBITDA a year, and the bridge plus a $1M fee matures 2027-06-28. The 10-Q says new funding is 'not yet probable' and that without it the company may curtail or sell assets. Prior raises: an August 2025 offering priced 23% below the prior close, and 18M shares sold at $2.00 in February 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: August 2025 offering: -17% premarket on pricing 23.4% below the close (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/why-is-boron-products-supplier-5-e-advanced-materials-falling-premarket/chsmy6KRd0N). 2026-10-07: -17% on the release disclosing the -$26M run-rate and ~$24M peak need. The Feb 2026 raise at $2.00 coincided with a drift from ~$2.2 to $1.72.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is down ~60% from its October high, which is what dilution fear looks like. What is not priced is the form and size of the raise. A non-dilutive working-capital facility backed by offtake (the Oct 7 'plan') would be a relief, and a discounted registered direct or ATM priced off a $1.55 stock would be the leg down. Answering the financing question as lesson 4 asks: the money funds restarting a loss-making operation, with no backlog yet corroborating a ramp, under a going-concern flag. That is the negative case, net of the possibility that a debt facility removes the overhang.
findings.independence: The Oct 7 release gives the ~$15M cash, $7M of $10M bridge funded and ~$24M peak need (https://www.newswire.com/news/5e-advanced-materials-provides-additional-details-on-integration-and-expected), a separate document. The DEF 14A records the Feb 2026 raise of 18M shares at $2.00 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888654/000119312526431898/feam-20261026.htm).

Most of the fall is explained (the Oct 7 details and dilution fear), and the Nov 5 leg is not. findings.finding: Mid-quarter statement (Oct 6 call, Oct 7 release): the as-acquired Searles business runs at -$26M of Adjusted EBITDA a year. The bridge to the ~$40M target is repricing +$22M (netbacks targeted more than 65% above the ~$424/short ton of predecessor contracts), cost reset +$10M and volume plus byproducts +$33M. Positive EBITDA is expected only in year two and not in full this fiscal year. V-BOR runs at ~82k short tons annualised against a 100k target, with no restart date for the SAC plant. Five weeks of operations are therefore expected to be loss-making, and the company has already said so.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-10-07, the day these numbers came out, the stock fell 17% ($3.76 to $3.11) on 1.8M shares.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the -17% day and the slide since. The residual risk is that five weeks of actual numbers (sales, cash burn at Searles) come in at or below the -$26M run-rate while repricing has not yet started, confirming the loss in concrete figures. A first loss-making print within guided expectations is inside what the company told the market, hence the small size.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1888654/000119312526463406/feam-20260930.htm) says the acquired operations need more working capital and capital investment to stabilise production and are in early integration. Another mid-quarter statement: CEO open-market buy on 2026-10-08 (see below). Mid-quarter statements after the Oct 7 release: none found besides the Nov 11 call notice, which carried no numbers.

findings.finding: Next guide: no numeric guidance exists, and the likeliest outcome is that the company maintains the Oct 7 base plan and adds early specifics: repricing wins against the $424/st predecessor netback, a SAC restart date, and the financing route. With five weeks of ownership, neither a raise nor a cut is likely. The swing factor is whether management quantifies contract repricing (the single largest bridge item, +$22M) as already signed.

No sourced evidence points either way, hence 0 with a wide band.

baseline_tension: There is no skew and the baseline is 'thin'. The negative financing lean runs with the -39% 20-day run-up rather than against it, and the depth of that drawdown together with a not-crowded short book is what keeps p_up close to 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the expectations/drawdown finding was cut from +2.0 to +1.0, because part of the fall (the Nov 5 leg) has no cause and the rest is explained dilution fear.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): answered. The money funds the restart of a loss-making operation under a going-concern flag with no corroborated ramp, so the -3.0 financing finding stands.
Lesson 7: short interest was checked (6% of float, 1.15 days to cover, not crowded), so the negative is not shrunk for squeeze risk.
Lesson 8 (thin coverage moves more): abs_move_pct raised from 14 to 15 against the name's 15-30% event-day history.
Pessimism artefact note: p_up moved from 45 to 46.
Lesson 6: the bar is unsourced and the quarter pre-released, so every finding stays at small or capped size; the overhang and debt maturities stay in outside_window.
